verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a customizable scheduling link and booking page, available on the Free plan, and shareable via website, LinkedIn and email. It syncs multiple calendars to check for conflicts before someone books, with buffers, custom schedules and daily limits. Multiple hands-on users confirm invitees pick from live free slots with no back-and-forth email, and that checking multiple calendars is a standout strength. missing for 10: one user reports availability often shown inaccurately (calendly-comm-19), leaving slight doubt on 'live' accuracy.
